name: ENCODE Toolkit
summary: A single-plugin Claude Code marketplace providing MCP tools and skills for working with the ENCODE Project functional-genomics data resource.
description: A Claude Code marketplace by Dr. Alex M. Mawla (UC Davis) bundling one content-dense plugin, encode-toolkit: 20 MCP tools plus 47 expert skills for the ENCODE (Encyclopedia of DNA Elements) Project, an NHGRI-funded functional-genomics data consortium. The plugin covers searching ENCODE experiments, downloading files with MD5 verification, running pipelines, and cross-referencing 14 ENCODE-related databases. Catalogued here under this registry's bundle admission test (internal project documentation Phase 10): not itself a GA4GH-sponsored project, but a real, publicly discoverable collection with a concrete genomics-research relevance fact -- ENCODE is a named, real, government-funded genomics data resource, the same class of fact as the registry's first bundle entry's Synapse.org link. Only one plugin is listed, but its scope (20 tools, 47 skills, one named external data resource) is substantive rather than a thin wrapper. Terms check: the repository carries a real root LICENSE file (GNU AGPLv3, confirmed by direct fetch), and the README states plainly "License: AGPL-3.0. See LICENSE for full terms", with no "or later" language found anywhere in the repository, so license is recorded as the SPDX-precise agpl-3.0-only identifier rather than the ambiguous bare AGPL-3.0 GitHub reports. None of its plugin names collide with this registry's own seeded plugin entries (all ga4gh-* slugs), so ga4gh.members is empty.
